label: Fires at GO after an unrewarded S2 visit, more so late in the episode and when belief favours S1.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * ((prev_state == 2) > prev_reward) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * ((prev_state == 2) > prev_reward) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * ((prev_state == 2) > prev_reward) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (belief > 0.5)
explanation: Very sparse feature (nonzero on 1.2% of steps), active only at GO and mostly late in the episode (timing baseline peaks in deciles 7-8). Beyond timing, its magnitude goes up at GO when the previous trial reached S2 and was not rewarded (a1 S2 u and a2 S2 u residuals +0.015 to +0.018; every other previous-trial pattern is slightly negative). That effect gets bigger later in the episode, when the observer belief leans toward S1 being good, and when the trial before that was rewarded. The free fit adds a choice-independent unrewarded-late-episode term and a belief>0.5 term, and splits a1 S2 u from a2 S2 u (prev_action). The future choice adds nothing. All additive explanations are small (the all-cue ceiling is 0.08) because the activation is rare and heavy-tailed: the largest activations (~0.8) are single GO steps that the fits predict at only ~0.05-0.07.
